_help: Newest first. Add a post by copying blog/_TEMPLATE.html to blog/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.html, then put a new object at the top of posts. date is YYYY-MM-DD. dateLabel is optional display text. url must match the file. image may be an empty string. See README.md.

posts.title: Turn the Hearts
posts.excerpt: Malachi 4:6 and Luke 1:17 call for a father's heart to turn toward his children. When that turning is real, a child is known, a wife is no longer alone in the raising, and a home is made ready for the Lord.
posts.imageAlt: A father reading the Bible with his son and daughter at the kitchen table

posts.title: Two Are Better Than One
posts.excerpt: A husband and wife face stress, money, illness, conflict, and spiritual attack together. Ecclesiastes 4:9–12 calls a man to stand with his wife, with Christ as the third strand, so his wife, his children, and his home are held.
posts.imageAlt: An open Bible, a journal with a pen, and a mug on a wooden table.

posts.title: Go After the One
posts.excerpt: Jesus leaves the ninety and nine to go after the one lost sheep. The first mission field for a man is his own home, then the one man who has wandered from God, and being present is how he goes after them.
posts.imageAlt: Black woven Reach One bracelets on a wooden table. One band reads REACH ONE and the other has a shepherd's hook tag, beside a Bible.

posts.title: As for Me and My House
posts.excerpt: Joshua 24:15 calls a man to decide, and to lead, that his household will serve the Lord. When he is present in worship, his wife, his children, and his home receive a clear direction in a busy age.
posts.imageAlt: An open Bible, a journal with a pen, and a mug on a wooden table.

posts.title: Do Not Grow Weary
posts.excerpt: The long work of a husband and a present father can make a man want to quit. Galatians 6:9 calls him to keep doing good at home, and a wife, a child, and a house are steadied when he does not give up.
posts.imageAlt: An open Bible, a journal with a pen, and a mug on a wooden table.

posts.title: Love Her as Christ
posts.excerpt: A man who loves his wife as Christ loved the church spends himself for her good, and that love steadies the marriage, teaches the children, and gives the home the shape of Jesus.
posts.imageAlt: An open Bible, a journal with a pen, and a mug on a wooden table.

posts.title: A Soft Answer
posts.excerpt: Anger rises in every marriage and every home. A man who answers softly turns the heat down, protects his wife and children, and shows them Christ.
posts.imageAlt: An open Bible, a journal with a pen, and a mug on a wooden table.

posts.title: Before the Sun Goes Down
posts.excerpt: Husbands and wives face anger together. A man who will not let the sun go down on his wrath keeps bitterness from settling on his wife, his children, and his home.
posts.imageAlt: An open Bible, a journal with a pen, and a mug on a wooden table.

posts.title: Teach Them Diligently
posts.excerpt: Faith is handed down at the dinner table, in the truck, and at bedtime, when a man talks of God's words there and not only on Sunday.
posts.imageAlt: An open Bible, a journal with a pen, and a mug on a wooden table.

posts.title: A Place of Refuge
posts.excerpt: A present father gives his children a refuge, stands beside his wife, and teaches the home whom it serves.
posts.imageAlt: An open Bible, a journal with a pen, and a mug on a wooden table.

posts.title: Pray With Her
posts.excerpt: Husbands and wives face real battles together. A husband who takes the lead in praying with his wife strengthens the marriage and the home.
posts.imageAlt: An open Bible, a journal with a pen, and a mug on a wooden table.

posts.title: More Than a Paycheck
posts.excerpt: A paycheck can keep a household, and God calls a father to provide. Children still need his time, his attention, and a man who will lead them to Jesus.
posts.imageAlt: An open Bible, a journal with a pen, and a mug on a wooden table.

posts.title: Stay in the Room
posts.excerpt: Husbands and wives fight real battles. A father who stays in the room — listening, repenting, and praying — changes the temperature of the home.
posts.imageAlt: An open Bible, a journal with a pen, and a mug on a wooden table.

posts.title: What It Means to Reach One
posts.excerpt: Jesus left the ninety-nine to go after the one. That same mission still matters today. Who is the one person God may be calling you to pray for, encourage, and point back to Him?
posts.imageAlt: Black woven Reach One bracelets on a wooden table. One band reads REACH ONE and the other has a shepherd's hook tag, beside a Bible.
